notes.title: Get the Development Book & Soundtrack DLC!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that exclusive DLC for Reaplaced is now available:

Award-Winning Soundtrack https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631660/Reaplaced_Soundtrack/

The soundtrack contains 7 songs (~15 minutes total) which you can preview on its store page.

70+ Page Development Book https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631730/Reaplaced_Development_Book/

In the DevBook PDF, you'll learn tips and tricks from the creators of Detective Butler, Methods, SoulSet, and Game of Fourtune as we worked together to create Reaplaced within 30 days!

All proceeds from the DLCs will be reinvested back into the Mystery Gamedev community!

Our mission is to create the #1 community for fans and developers of mystery-themed video games.

If you haven't already, feel free to join us on Discord and subscribe to our newsletter, where we provide tools and resources for aspiring mystery game developers.

Thank you for your support, and Happy Halloween!
